sv.title: Håkan Boström: Högerpopulismens olika ansikten
sv.summary: En ny bok visar hur olika staters skilda historia spelar en avgörande roll för hur deras högerpopulister anpassar sig till den liberala demokratin.

en.title: Håkan Boström: The various faces of right-wing populism
en.summary: A new book shows how the distinct histories of different states play a decisive role in how their right-wing populists adapt to liberal democracy.
